description.zh: 给核验通过的公众号文章配封面和正文插图：先读懂文章、规划配图位置（封面、开头、第几段后、哪个小标题后），能搜到授权清楚的图就用搜索的（官方发布、CC 协议、公有领域、免费图库，记录图片地址、来源页、署名和授权，授权不明的不用），搜不到就调用生图模型生成（提示词写清主体、风格、构图和色调，封面按 2.35:1 裁剪，图注自动标“AI 生成”）；配图登记在文章包的“配图单”里、不改初稿，核验报告不会因此过期；把图文排成预览 PDF 给用户预览，再经共享文件夹把图片和文章包交给发布专员。是内容团队核验之后、发布之前的一站。
description.en: Illustrates fact-checked WeChat articles with a cover and inline images: reads the article, plans where images go (cover, opening, after paragraph N, after a heading), uses searched images only when the licence is clear (official releases, Creative Commons, public domain, free stock; image URL, source page, credit and licence recorded) and otherwise generates them with the image model (prompts cover subject, style, composition and palette; covers cropped to 2.35:1; captions labelled AI-generated); figures go into the pack's figure list without touching the draft, so the review stays valid; exports a preview PDF for the user and hands images and the pack to the publisher through the shared folder. The content team's step after fact-checking and before publishing.

welcome_message.zh: 把要配图的文章（或文章包的共享名）发给我，说说账号喜欢什么风格
welcome_message.en: Send me the article (or the pack's shared name) and tell me the account's visual style

prompt.zh: 帮这篇文章配图：封面 1 张、正文 2–3 张，风格 ___，先搜官方或免费图库的图，搜不到再生成，最后给我一份预览 PDF。文章包共享名 ___。
prompt.en: Illustrate this article: one cover and 2–3 inline images in a ___ style; search official or free stock images first and generate the rest, then give me a preview PDF. Pack shared name: ___.

prompt.zh: 给这篇文章做一张公众号封面，横版 2.35:1，风格 ___，画面里不要文字。文章：___
prompt.en: Make a WeChat cover for this article, 2.35:1 landscape, ___ style, no text in the image. Article: ___

prompt.zh: 把文章包 ___ 的初稿和配图排好，导出一份预览 PDF 给我看。
prompt.en: Lay out the draft and figures of pack ___ and export a preview PDF for me.

prompt.zh: 这几张图我想用在公众号文章里：___，帮我查来源页的授权、该怎么署名，不能用的换成生成图。
prompt.en: I want to use these images in an article: ___; check each source page's licence and credit, and replace any that can't be used with generated ones.

prompt.zh: 配图单里的 ___ 不合适，原因是 ___，换一张（可以重新生成），更新配图单和预览 PDF。
prompt.en: Figure ___ doesn't work because ___; replace it (regenerate if needed) and update the figure list and preview PDF.

prompt.zh: 配图已经确认，把图片和文章包放进共享文件夹，告诉我给发布专员的共享名。
prompt.en: The figures are approved; put the images and the pack into the shared folder and tell me the shared names for the publisher.

zh: 每篇文章核验通过后「立即」配图并生成预览 PDF
每天「17:00」给当天核验通过的文章补齐封面
每周一「10:00」检查上周配图的授权记录是否完整
每次用户改稿后「立即」检查配图位置是否还对得上
每月 1 日「9:00」整理上月用过的免费图库来源和署名
每次发布前「立即」把图片和文章包放进共享文件夹
en: Whenever an article passes fact-checking, illustrate it and export a preview PDF
Every day at 17:00, add covers to articles approved today
Every Monday at 10:00, check last week's figure licence records are complete
Whenever the user edits a draft, check figure positions still match
On the 1st of each month at 9:00, list last month's stock sources and credits
Before every publish, put images and the pack into the shared folder
